about_the_game:
Love Hotel Manager is a game where you own your own Love hotel! Manage and customize unique and whacky rooms while dealing with strange customers and their needs. Slowly expand your hotel to become a thriving business.

CUSTOMIZE ROOMS

Love hotels are notorious for their unique rooms and themes. Have fun with strange novelty rooms or making more hip and stylish ones. Let your creativity run wild!

CUSTOMER NEEDS
Your rooms have different stats based on your furniture. Customers will have personal preferences as well as special customers and other quirky characters with wants of their own.

EXPAND

Expand your hotel and add more rooms and maximize your profitability to have the ultimate love hotel business!

content_descriptors.notes: Innuendo and sexual language but nothing shown.
